observations.result: a live call showed the retrieval client reading the completion from a response field the installed broker does not populate, so an answer that had already been paid for was discarded
the focused suite's in-process broker double answered in the same wrong shape, so the suite reported every check passing over a client that could not work against the installed broker
the passing result recorded before the correction was not evidence of a working client; this record preserves that the green was false rather than restating the suite's own verdict
the client and its test double were both changed to the response shape the installed broker actually returns, so the double's fidelity to the real component is what the suite now depends on
